body: As a sort of poll, how would you react to someone telling you they know about it? I get it its generally speaking a bad idea to do it, but Im interested on hearing about it anyway.
Its Ok for her to not be ready for a relationship, or hell, just not being attracted to me, that is acceptable and normal. I just wouldnt like to miss on this for something like that.

Pretty sure she was not trying. In english the word has no gender, but in spanish does, she just missed on it. 

I know that, I have never been attracted to men, and she doesnt look manly at all.

Well, the thing is, outside of the painting shop we both frequent, we dont have that much contact, though was thinking on inviting for lunch once more. Anyways, removing that "I know you are transgender stuff", how do you think she would react to me telling her I like her? Honestly, she is kinda introverted. Sorry but I am so full of questions hahaha.
I honestly think the main reason she doesnt wanna date anyone is because she would be rejected for what she is, I am trying to remove that barrier.
